findings.quote: Treat this as a ritual you repeat at the start of every session.
findings.harm: The rule prevents the loop being taught as ceremony, the exact thing the compounding practice exists to replace. Present here, and worse than a lexical slip: the sentence actively instructs the student to treat a repeatable engineering move as a ritual, so the banned word is carrying the wrong pedagogy, not just the wrong register.

findings.quote: This section previously said something different; it was fixed on 2026-01-14.

A reader who never saw the previous version loses nothing if it vanishes, which is the rule's own tense test returning cut.
